# pdf.js 4.10.38

The PDF reader in the Library (`src/library/Reader.js`).

- Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js (npm `pdfjs-dist@4.10.38`)
- Licence: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`)
- `pdf.min.mjs` and `pdf.worker.min.mjs` are `build/` from the package, unchanged.
  The text-layer styles the reader needs are in `library.css`.
